guarantees.claim: If SP2V_LOGIC_HIGH[i] is 1, an instance of aes_cipher_control_fsm_p is instantiated; otherwise an instance of aes_cipher_control_fsm_n is used. All outputs of the selected FSM are directly connected to the corresponding array bits at index i.
guarantees.cond: Compile time, for each i from 0 to Sp2VWidth-1.

assumptions.claim: For each bit i, the sparsified control inputs (sp_in_valid, sp_crypt, sp_dec_key_gen, sp_sub_bytes_out_req, sp_key_expand_out_req, sp_crypt_q, sp_dec_key_gen_q, and their de-asserted variants) must have an active level (high vs low) consistent with SP2V_LOGIC_HIGH[i].
assumptions.cond: During normal operation, while the FSM is actively processing.
assumptions.risk: Polarity mismatch can cause the FSM to misread handshakes or commands, potentially yielding incorrect AES round sequencing, data corruption, or insecure state that may leak key material.

uncertain_points.claim: The per-bit mr_alert[i] signals are intended to be OR-combined externally; if the combining logic is glitch-prone or incorrectly implemented, a fatal alert may be missed.
uncertain_points.cond: External OR-combine circuit not shown in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected fatal errors could violate security guarantees and allow further operation in a compromised state.

uncertain_points.claim: mr_key_clear_d[i] and mr_data_out_clear_d[i] are marked AND-combine externally. If the combination fails, the internal clear may not be asserted, leaving key or sensitive data uncleared.
uncertain_points.cond: External AND-combine logic must assure that a clear is requested only when all bits agree in a manner consistent with the security policy.
uncertain_points.risk: Key material or plaintext could persist after a clear operation, directly violating data wipe requirements.

uncertain_points.claim: mr_prng_reseed_d[i] is intended for AND combination; an incorrect combine could delay or drop a PRNG reseed request, weakening the entropy source.
uncertain_points.cond: External AND-combine logic must reliably reflect a consensus reset request.
uncertain_points.risk: Reduced entropy quality may compromise masking or key generation, lowering the overall security strength.
